captions.summary: K1 exchangeable pooled-rank global scan: conservative on the correlated-GRF self-consistency check with a live anti-conservative negative control (max exceedance 0.00), then applied to the real Planck PR3 FFP10 end-to-end SMICA null (300 CMB Monte-Carlo maps each paired with a real noise Monte-Carlo map, drawn from the 999 CMB and 300 noise maps available) giving an E2E-conditional pooled-rank global p of 0.037 on the exchangeable support grid. PR3/FFP10-E2E-conditional morphology diagnostic only; the idealised GRF is never a Planck calibration; PR4/NPIPE is a non-numeric skip; no detection or Bianchi-family claim; the two CF4 P0s stay OPEN.
